prs.cluster_pick_reason: #1996 adds a dedicated acceptsMediaType() helper that does proper Accept-header parsing: splits on commas for multiple media ranges, strips whitespace/case, parses q-parameters and excludes entries with q=0, and compares type/subtype tokens (with wildcard support). #2046 instead swaps the boolean condition to a plain acceptHeader?.includes('application/json') substring check, which does not honor q=0 (would wrongly accept an explicitly excluded type) and is vulnerable to false-positive substring matches on related media types (e.g. 'application/json-patch+json'). #1996's parser is the more spec-correct implementation of the two.

prs.cluster_pick_reason: #2215 fixes a functional bug, not just a cleanup: shouldAttemptFallback compared the normalized pathname against '/' to detect the root path, but buildDiscoveryUrls already normalized root to '' (via the pre-existing single-slice strip), so the root check never matched and a redundant fallback discovery request was always fired for root-path servers. #2215 fixes this by introducing a shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper that canonicalizes both '' and '/' to '', and updates the shouldAttemptFallback comparison to '' to match. #2214 only replaces the trailing-slash regex in buildWellKnownPath and buildDiscoveryUrls (a `.slice()` single-strip -> `.replace(/\/+$/, '')` multi-strip change to handle inputs like '/foo//') but does not touch shouldAttemptFallback, so it leaves the root-fallback bug unfixed. Note: #2215's diff does not update buildDiscoveryUrls's separate pathname-stripping block the way #2214 does, so that multi-slash edge case (e.g. '/foo//') should be folded into #2215 (or applied as a follow-up) using the same regex it already introduces in normalizeDiscoveryPath before closing #2214.

members.cluster_pick_reason: #2215 fixes a functional bug, not just a cleanup: shouldAttemptFallback compared the normalized pathname against '/' to detect the root path, but buildDiscoveryUrls already normalized root to '' (via the pre-existing single-slice strip), so the root check never matched and a redundant fallback discovery request was always fired for root-path servers. #2215 fixes this by introducing a shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper that canonicalizes both '' and '/' to '', and updates the shouldAttemptFallback comparison to '' to match. #2214 only replaces the trailing-slash regex in buildWellKnownPath and buildDiscoveryUrls (a `.slice()` single-strip -> `.replace(/\/+$/, '')` multi-strip change to handle inputs like '/foo//') but does not touch shouldAttemptFallback, so it leaves the root-fallback bug unfixed. Note: #2215's diff does not update buildDiscoveryUrls's separate pathname-stripping block the way #2214 does, so that multi-slash edge case (e.g. '/foo//') should be folded into #2215 (or applied as a follow-up) using the same regex it already introduces in normalizeDiscoveryPath before closing #2214.

clusters.pick_reason: #2215 fixes a functional bug, not just a cleanup: shouldAttemptFallback compared the normalized pathname against '/' to detect the root path, but buildDiscoveryUrls already normalized root to '' (via the pre-existing single-slice strip), so the root check never matched and a redundant fallback discovery request was always fired for root-path servers. #2215 fixes this by introducing a shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper that canonicalizes both '' and '/' to '', and updates the shouldAttemptFallback comparison to '' to match. #2214 only replaces the trailing-slash regex in buildWellKnownPath and buildDiscoveryUrls (a `.slice()` single-strip -> `.replace(/\/+$/, '')` multi-strip change to handle inputs like '/foo//') but does not touch shouldAttemptFallback, so it leaves the root-fallback bug unfixed. Note: #2215's diff does not update buildDiscoveryUrls's separate pathname-stripping block the way #2214 does, so that multi-slash edge case (e.g. '/foo//') should be folded into #2215 (or applied as a follow-up) using the same regex it already introduces in normalizeDiscoveryPath before closing #2214.
